sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: First in Line is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Greetings, young man. I need you to complete a quick assignment for me. Nothing too extraordinary yet, we have only just begun working together. There are still civilians in the city, and they're trying to get out. The best place to organize an evacuation would be the Emercom checkpoint: it should have both the vehicles and the necessary equipment. At least, I hope so. I haven't been to that part of the city very often, so I don't know exactly where the checkpoint is located. Find it for me. Once you do, I'll send my people to inspect the area. And one more thing. I'm in need of supplies for my medical duty. I can't exactly import them to Tarkov anymore, so we have to look for what we can find. It doesn't matter what you bring: consumables, medicine, stimulants. Anything useful will do. I'll be waiting."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the Emercom station on Ground Zero
- Hand over any 3 found in raid medicine items

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Therapist Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Mission accomplished? That's great news, thank you. I hope that our cooperation will be equally productive in the future."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to find the Emercom station on Ground Zero, and hand over any 3 found in raid medical items to Therapist.

The Emercom station can be found in front of the "Unity Credit" bank.
